newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to softer, may ease furthe.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to softer, may ease furthe.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to softer in early trade on Thursday, but business was thin with the lengthy supplies of most product keeping buyers relaxed.
Traders said the market was looking for fresh direction but unless one of the political or OPEC headlines gave the market fresh impetus they expected prices to drift lower.
"Inventories in Europe are very comfortable" one said.

Barge talk was very thin with gas oil buyers around July IPE -75 cents and sellers at screen flat. Buyers were scarce for gasoline but trader pegged offers slightly softer for eurograde at $189 and steady for regular at $183 a tonne fob ARA.
High sulphur fuel oil buyers and sellers were at stand-off and prices were slightly softer at $82/84 a tonne fob ARA.
